courses.title: Economic Analysis of Energy Markets
courses.description: This course uses economic analysis to explain the history of world energy and its regulation since 1945.

courses.description: Introduction to theory of finance and application of financial tools to commodity market analysis. Emphasis on mineral and energy markets.
